issue.title: 8x8 stream input ports own no AUDIO_CLUSTER, against Milan 5.3.3.8
issue.body:
[A10] Found by processor #122's clause disposition (Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan#122, issuecomment-5853884588, by [A348]).

## Observed

- Milan v1.2 §5.3.3.8 (printed p. 27): each Stream Port Input of a Configuration shall contain at least one AUDIO_CLUSTER descriptor. The same clause sets the output minimum.
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 §7.2.13 (Table 7-23) keeps `number_of_clusters` separate from `number_of_maps`. Dynamic mapping zeroes the latter, not the former.
- The ALINX 8x8 shape (`configs/endstation_ax7101_8x8.yaml`) declares `physical_channels: {capture: 0, render: 0}`, because the AX7101 has no audio I/O. Following D8 (`docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md`, "D8 — role-named 8×8 port model"), its 8 STREAM_PORT_INPUTs therefore own **zero** clusters. That model is non-conforming.
- D8's goal of advertising no capability the fabric cannot back is right, but it cannot be met by breaking §5.3.3.8.
- The shipping 1x1 TDM8 is conforming: its input port owns its 8 backed render clusters.

## Objective

Every STREAM_PORT_INPUT of every tracked configuration owns at least one AUDIO_CLUSTER. Each cluster's meaning is stated in the model and backed by fabric behaviour wherever the configuration provides a sink.

## Decision first

The author publishes a DECISION comment here before any dependent edit, and the manager approves it. The comment:
- lists the sinks the 8x8 fabric actually offers for received audio (for example the loopback lane when it is built, or the RX monitor / PCM path) and which of them the shipping 8x8 build selects;
- proposes the cluster pool for input ports, derived from the configuration and never hardcoded;
- states what a mapping to each cluster does on the wire and in the fabric.

If no backed sink exists in a configuration, the decision states how the model stays conforming without claiming a capability it lacks (a documented unrouted cluster), and why.

## Acceptance

1. The builder emits conforming input ports for all tracked configurations. The builder refuses a configuration whose STREAM_PORT_INPUT or STREAM_PORT_OUTPUT would own zero clusters, with a named refusal and a test.
2. D8 and `docs/reference/PP_DESCRIPTOR_OWNERSHIP.md` are updated, with the processor #122 disposition linked.
3. The 8x8 image grows within the store and line-buffer bounds; report the sizes. The model identity rotates as the #495 evolution rules require.
4. The 1x1 TDM8 artifacts are byte-identical. The Arty configurations keep building (#583).

ALINX focus. Backlog.

Selecting TDM32 capture/master does not select render. | | Received AAF audio forwarded to talkers through the capture mux's `SRC_LOOP` bucket | [milan_datapath.sv:1268](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv#L1268), [:5869](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv#L5869), [KL_chan_map_capture.sv:962](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/hdl/ieee1722/aaf/KL_chan_map_capture.sv#L962) | No: `fabric.loopback_lane=false`; the accepted-payload strobe is tied off. With the lane enabled, **output** mappings select received stream/channel samples for transmitted AAF channels; input mappings do not control this tap. | The selecting facts are [8x8 YAML:40](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/configs/endstation_ax7101_8x8.yaml#L40), [:186](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/configs/endstation_ax7101_8x8.yaml#L186), [:222–248](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/configs/endstation_ax7101_8x8.yaml#L222). Generated argv has neither `--loopback-lane` nor `--audio-interface-render`; [milan_soc.py:990](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/sw/litex/milan_soc.py#L990) gates `LOOPBACK_P`. Pilot tone is a talker source, not a received-audio sink. Latency/probe observations are not channel destinations either; this configuration prunes them. Pool rule: retain existing policies and nonempty physical input pools. For a `role-pools` input with zero render channels, construct an `unrouted` pool of `listeners[p].channels` mono MBLA clusters. This is configuration-derived, independent of TDM interface width and talker loopback width. Thus each 8x8 input owns **8 clusters**, `channel_count=1`, named `Unrouted S

ch ` (use the configured channel name in place of `ch ` when supplied). These labels identify logical destinations, not fixed source bindings. Input bases become `0,8,…,56`; output bases become `64,73,…,127`, preserving each output's nine-cluster pool and relative offsets. All input ports retain `number_of_maps=0`; CRF still has no Stream Port. Mapping behavior: a legal ADD row `(stream=s, channel=c, cluster_offset=k, cluster_channel=0)` selects that logical destination in the protocol store; GET returns it, REMOVE clears it. Each 8x8 input has one fixed eight-entry GET page, initially empty. Normal bounds, atomicity, lock and format-coherence rules remain. Every new cluster has an invalid physical projection, so **no physical sample route, monitor selection or talker payload changes**. The existing commit path writes the protocol store but pulses the render write only for a valid projection ([builder:2828](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/sw/builder/endstation_builder.py#L2828), [datapath:4350](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv#L4350)). Received media therefore terminates without a routed consumer. An enabled loopback lane remains independently controlled by output mappings. Physical input clusters, where present, retain their existing listener-channel-to-render-slot behavior. This makes a configuration without a backed mapped sink satisfy the cluster/mapping clauses without inventing a physical or forwarding capability. Milan §5.3.3.8 requires a cluster, not a physical jack; IEEE §7.2.16 permits the input cluster's `signal_type=INVALID`, `signal_index=0`. Explicit names, zero physical projection and no automatic input mapping state the limitation. A valid logical mapping must not be described as an audible route, nor rejected merely because its cluster has no pin. This is a bounded model correction, not a claim of complete product conformance. Scratch measurement used the unchanged builder's `_derive_artifacts` and artifact writer, with only an in-memory override of empty input pools and their namer, then the normal `gen_aem_store` → `gen_aemi_image` → processor `gen_desc_image.build(..., 576)` pipeline. The processor pin was `0922e43408f891fc0b84a84691df86b4fd0f1c0d`. No tracked files were edited. | Configuration | Packed bytes before → proposed | Input clusters per port | Comparison | |---|---:|---|---| | ax7101_8x8 | 18,288 → **28,528** | 0 → 8 | 116 → 180 descriptors; 72 → 136 clusters | | ax7101_1x1_tdm8 | 7,352 → 7,352 | 8 | Byte-identical | | arty_current | 5,792 → 5,792 | 8 | Byte-identical | | arty_4x4 | 10,112 → 10,112 | 4 | Byte-identical | | arty_8ch | 15,360 → 15,360 | 8 | Byte-identical | Growth is `64 × (96-byte packed cluster stride + 64-byte name) = 10,240 B`. The 64 KiB AEM flash slot retains **37,008 B**; the first reserved DRAM stage begins 913,408 B above the descriptor base. The maximum descriptor remains **452/576 B** (clusters are 90 B); index entries remain **15/32**. The legacy generated ROM is 16,809 B plus 64 B scratch, below its 65,536 B bound. Bounds: [aem_assemble.py:314](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/avdecc/aem_assemble.py#L314), [milan_soc.py:117](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/sw/litex/milan_soc.py#L117), [:2930](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/sw/litex/milan_soc.py#L2930), [datapath:330](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv#L330). Generated name capacity grows **99 → 163** (+4,096 B); input-map keys grow **1 placeholder → 64**. [datapath:7407](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv#L7407) consumes that name capacity. These size results do not establish FPGA fit; implementation must recheck resource/timing effects. ADP remains nine sources/nine sinks, with `0x4801` talker/listener capabilities and unchanged entity ID. The existing count/base/page hash inputs rotate the 8x8 model ID from `0x001BC572F79BC5D1` to **`0x001BC5616F448DA5`** in this probe. Carry that derived identity consistently through ENTITY and firmware/ADP, as IEEE §6.2.2.8 and [#495](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/495) require. No global layout-revision bump: the other four identities stay unchanged. Their ten emitted builder files and packed image/manifest/map compare byte-for-byte equal. The 1x1 image SHA-256 remains `9b077636b1d42aca660b16dce8eafa06f1e3cac842134e51ba65930d16214404`. All five scratch generations succeed; Arty coverage must remain in the implementation regression under #583. Add a common builder `ConfigError` refusal named **`STREAM_PORT_CLUSTER_MINIMUM`**, identifying `STREAM_PORT_INPUT/OUTPUT`, port index and Milan §5.3.3.8 whenever final pool resolution yields zero clusters. Remove the current input exception at [builder:1534](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/sw/builder/endstation_builder.py#L1534); retain output all-pools-zero refusal through the same named check. Planned tests: - `test_stream_port_cluster_minimum`: separate zero-input and zero-output resolved-layout controls, one-cluster positives, and the all-output-pools-zero YAML refusal; removing the common guard must fail the controls. - Update builder gates 6, 16c, 24a–24d and 28: decode every tracked image, require nonempty ports/mono clusters/dense ownership, vary listener widths to prove derivation, verify names and all 64 invalid 8x8 projections, identity rotation and four-configuration byte identity. - Replace the obsolete zero-cluster assertions in `tb/verilator/milan_dp/sim_nxn.cpp` with actual ADD/GET/REMOVE tests at first/last ports and offsets, a full page, invalid cluster/channel/stream, atomic failure, reset and locking. Prove no physical alias or output-map change. Exercise the **shipping lane-off** shape as well as lane-on; today's [8x8 recipe](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/e0920d77162284d8da52ffaf13a973e451e44f90/tb/verilator/milan_dp/Makefile#L487) explicitly enables loopback. Retain the 1x1 TDM render regression. After approval, update D1/D2/D8, the descriptor census and schema rows, CHANNEL_MAP_64 and PP_DESCRIPTOR_OWNERSHIP with this meaning and the processor #122 disposition. Run the builder/generator tests, affected datapath/render suites and required repository gates before review; none is claimed by this decision-phase packing probe. Rejected alternatives: retain zero clusters (violates §5.3.3.8); remove input ports while retaining AAF listeners (violates §5.3.3.7); add static input AUDIO_MAPs (violates §§5.3.3.7/.9); invent physical render channels or name clusters as monitor/loopback destinations (no input-map-controlled sink exists); enable loopback merely to repair descriptors (changes fabric/area and still does not route input mappings); hardcode eight clusters or use the TDM32 width (breaks configuration derivation); use one minimal placeholder per port (loses per-configured-channel naming/mapping granularity); rotate every model ID (needlessly changes the byte-identical configurations).

[A10] DECISION APPROVED: the [A351] proposal (issuecomment-5854191783) as written, with one added condition. - The pool rule: for a `role-pools` input with zero render channels, an `unrouted` pool of `listeners[p].channels` mono clusters, named `Unrouted S

ch ` (or the configured channel name). - These clusters have `signal_type=INVALID` and no physical projection. Mappings are accepted, stored and returned, and change no physical route, monitor selection or talker payload. - Backed physical pools are unchanged. - The named `STREAM_PORT_CLUSTER_MINIMUM` refusal applies to both directions; the input exception at `sw/builder/endstation_builder.py:1534` is removed. - The 8x8 model ID rotates. The other four configurations stay byte-identical. - The planned tests, including the shipping lane-off 8x8 shape in `sim_nxn`, are required. **Rationale:** Milan v1.2 §5.3.3.8 requires a cluster, not a physical jack. No input-map-controlled sink exists on the 8x8. The explicit "Unrouted" naming and invalid projection keep D8's rule that the model advertises no capability the fabric cannot back. One cluster per configured channel matches the 1x1's per-channel layout. **Added condition (area):** the input-map key space grows from 1 to 64 on a shape that already exceeds the device (#231). The implementation reports the OOC area delta of `milan_datapath` and `KL_pp_shadow` for the 8x8 against the base, using the repository recipe. If the delta exceeds 1% of the xc7a100t LUTs (634 LUT), STOP and report before review. The fallback (one unrouted cluster per port) is then the manager's call. Implementation starts after PR #585 (#573-#576) merges; both touch `sw/builder/endstation_builder.py`.

[A10] Implementation assigned. Executor [A367]; reviewers [R344] (internal) and [R345] (external). Branch `584-8x8-input-clusters`, reset to dev `9e9954e9` (PR #585 has merged). Implement the approved decision (issuecomment-5854199817), which is [A351]'s proposal (issuecomment-5854191783) plus the area STOP: if the 8x8 OOC delta of `milan_datapath` + `KL_pp_shadow` exceeds 634 LUT, stop and report before review. All the planned tests from the proposal are required, including the shipping lane-off 8x8 shape in `sim_nxn`. The #580 pin bump (PR #591) is in flight; this lane stays on the current pin.

[A367] TAKEN
Branch: `584-8x8-input-clusters`, base `9e9954e96bf55181edb9949ae94c9abd4ab6aaf5`.
Authoritative references: the approved proposal [issuecomment-5854191783](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5854191783), approval [issuecomment-5854199817](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5854199817), Milan v1.2 5.3.3.7-5.3.3.9, and processor #122's disposition.
Interpreted scope: implement configuration-derived unrouted input pools and the common cluster-minimum refusal; preserve physical pools and all four other configurations. Reviewers remain [R344] and [R345].
Validation plan: first capture all five artifact baselines and compare identical shipping-8x8 OOC recipes at base and head. Stop and report if the sum exceeds 634 LUT. If within the limit, complete the approved builder, image, wire, mutation and local gate coverage, including both 8x8 loopback settings.
Blockers: none identified. No publication of a branch or PR is authorized in this phase.

[A367] IMPLEMENTATION BLOCKER

The approved eight-cluster input pools generate 163 writable names (base: 99).
The required `python3 scripts/check_nvm_capture.py` exits 1 with:
`FAIL: endstation_ax7101_8x8: record allocation overflow`.

The existing saved-state allocation permits only 128 names (IDs `0x80..0xFF`).
`hdl/milan/KL_nvm_backend.sv:288` explicitly refuses `N_NAME_P > 128`.
`milan_datapath` forwards generated `AEM_NAME_ENTRIES_C` through
`KL_pp_shadow.DESC_NAME_ENTRIES_P` to that backend without truncation.
This is an allocation conflict in the approved design, not a measurement
threshold to relax. No guard, name count or saved-state allocation was changed.

Implementation edits have stopped. The already-running paired 8x8 area
measurements will finish so the area STOP can also be evaluated and reported.
Standalone `KL_pp_shadow` LUT_TOT is 71,135 -> 71,023 (-112), with RAMB36
16 -> 17; `milan_datapath` is still running. No review readiness is claimed.

The candidate's 8x8 image is 28,528 bytes and its model ID is
`0x001BC5616F448DA5`; all 13 captured artifacts of each other configuration
are byte-identical. The declaration suite, focused builder gates 6/16c/24/28,
generator self-test and five-configuration descriptor audit pass. The full
wire and builder matrix remains incomplete.

A public design disposition is required before dependent implementation resumes.
The existing approval reserves any reduced-cluster fallback to the maintainer.

[A367] AREA STOP — implementation stopped before review

The approved per-channel design exceeds the 634-LUT limit in [the approval](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5854199817).

| OOC top | Base LUT_TOT | Candidate LUT_TOT | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `KL_pp_shadow` | 71,135 | 71,023 | -112 |
| `milan_datapath` | 150,928 | 156,019 | +5,091 |
| Arithmetic sum | 222,063 | 227,042 | +4,979 |

The datapath delta alone exceeds 634. LUT_TOT includes distributed RAM; distributed RAM is unchanged in both tops, so the LUT-only deltas are identical. Both paired measurements exited 0.

Base and current HEAD: `9e9954e96bf55181edb9949ae94c9abd4ab6aaf5`. Candidate changes remain uncommitted on `584-8x8-input-clusters`; patch SHA-256: `91e5a2a607640bc6de523777aa30c16df2081dab8c12ad089a79393354809942` (27,682 bytes). No implementation commit, push or PR operation was performed.

Both measurements use the repository `syn/yosys/ooc.sh KL_pp_shadow milan_datapath` recipe, SHA-256 `39a46b5dae849702fcbe699d57ab59b64e51a0b7933e0a0c473b58c06e80176f`, selecting the shipping 8x8 parameters through private top copies and each stage's generated shape. The recipe relocations only select source, root and allocator paths. The processor pins and other RTL are unchanged. Parameters: 50 MHz; eight streams; eight-channel talkers; TDM32 master; zero render; loopback off; configured feature prunes; generated name capacity 99 before / 163 after. Reproduction script, full parameter receipts, area tables and log/netlist sizes and hashes are preserved with the blocked handoff.

There is also an independent [NVM allocation blocker](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5857093790): 163 names exceed the existing 128-name bound. `check_nvm_capture.py` exits 1. Both candidate synthesis logs report `N_NAME_P=163 outside 1..128`; the converted elaboration error does not force a synthesis failure. These resource measurements are therefore not evidence of a buildable candidate.

All 13 captured artifacts for each of the 1x1 TDM8 and three Arty configurations are byte-identical. The 8x8 packed image grows from 18,288 to 28,528 bytes; its model ID rotates from `0x001BC572F79BC5D1` to `0x001BC5616F448DA5`.

Validation and implementation are incomplete. The reduced-cluster fallback has not been implemented; it requires the maintainer's public design disposition. This is a blocked handoff, not REVIEW READY.

[A10] DECISION after [A367]'s area STOP (issuecomment-5857130496): the fallback. **One unrouted cluster per STREAM_PORT_INPUT** that has no backed sink. - The per-channel pool cost +5,091 LUT in `milan_datapath` (limit 634). It also needed 163 names against the 128-name allocation. - Milan v1.2 §5.3.3.8 requires at least one cluster, not one per channel. Rule: - For a `role-pools` input with zero render channels, the pool is exactly **one** mono cluster (`channel_count=1`, `signal_type=INVALID`, no physical projection), named `Unrouted S

`. - For the 8x8: 8 input clusters in total, 8 names (99 -> 107, within 128) and 8 input-map keys. - A mapping of any single stream channel onto it is stored and returned, and changes no route. - Everything else in the approved design stands: - the named `STREAM_PORT_CLUSTER_MINIMUM` refusal in both directions; - the 8x8 model ID rotates; - the 1x1 TDM8 and Arty artifacts stay byte-identical; - the tests, adapted to one cluster per port. STOP conditions (report before review if either triggers): 1. **Area.** The 8x8 OOC delta of `milan_datapath` + `KL_pp_shadow` exceeds 634 LUT. 2. **Capture.** The added name records change the 8x8 capture census, so `check_nvm_capture.py` requires a re-measure per `tb/verilator/nvm_capture_cpu/README.md` (#559 procedure). Re-measure both shapes. STOP if the 8x8 exceeds 24.5 ms. Do not change the gate or the copy; that remedy (a cheaper copy) is a separate manager decision. Start from the uncommitted round-1 patch (sha256 `91e5a2a6...`) and change the pool count to one. Executor [A369].

[A369] TAKEN Branch: `584-8x8-input-clusters`, base `9e9954e96bf55181edb9949ae94c9abd4ab6aaf5`. Authoritative references: approved proposal [issuecomment-5854191783](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5854191783), approval [issuecomment-5854199817](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5854199817), and fallback [issuecomment-5857155362](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/584#issuecomment-5857155362). Interpreted scope: adapt the inherited patch and tests to one unrouted mono cluster per input port without a backed render sink, named `Unrouted S

`. Preserve backed pools and the four other configurations. Reviewers remain [R344] and [R345].
